paragraphs.text:
You  dig  for  reserves  of  will  and  find  a  primitive  survival 
instinct. Abruptly, the pressure falls away and you are able to 
get to your feet.
You still face death by hunger.

Make a Hard POW roll: if you succeed, go to 161; if you fail, go 
to 68.
